summary: The checked-out implementation already contained internal input_layout/output_layout support, but the requested layout/out_layout API failed with TypeError and output did not inherit the input layout by default. Added the public layout='NCDHW', out_layout=None contract, retained the pre-public API spellings with conflict checks, and added GPU regressions for all relevant 3D layout directions, an NDHWC convolution chain, and split-K NDHWC output. On gfx950, five two-layer chains launched 10 transpose kernels with default NCDHW and zero with NDHWC while launching 10 convolution kernels in both cases.

gpu_execution.evidence: PyTorch 2.9.1+rocm7.2.0 ran on AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. Focused and full GPU suites passed, PyTorch reference comparisons passed, and ROCTracer captured the actual device kernels.

remaining_limitations: The kernel remains bf16-only and requires CDNA4/gfx95x for its mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16 instruction path.
NDHWC input avoids the NCDHW-to-NDHWC transpose only when supplied in the promised contiguous channels-last logical layout; non-contiguous NDHWC inputs are materialized with contiguous().

Forced or selected split-K still accumulates into an fp32 (npq, K) staging buffer. NDHWC returns a view/conversion of that staging result without a spatial/channel transpose; NCDHW still performs the final layout copy.

Non-zero reflect/replicate/circular padding and asymmetric same-padding can materialize padding and may change layout internally; the no-transpose claim is for the ordinary zero-padding chained-convolution path.

The requested dominant production shapes were not run at full size; bounded representative shapes were used to stay within the assigned validation budget. Full 62-case kernel coverage ran on the assigned gfx950 GPU.

No native C++ files changed, so the prepared native rebuild command was not applicable. The imported native library remained /opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/flydsl/_mlir; Python sources came from /job/repo.
